section:
Class List Here are the classes, structs, unions and interfaces with brief descriptions:Code.Scripts.Components.AnimationHandler
Handles the animations of the tanks Code.Scripts.Enemies.BasicBehaviour
Basic behaivour of the basic (red) enemy Code.Scripts.Weapons.BasicBullet
Controls the basic (50cal) bullet Code.Scripts.Enemies.Behaviour
Abstract class that defines the behaivour of an enemy. Provides utility methods for pathfinding and target selection Code.Scripts.Weapons.BouncingBullet
Controls the bouncing bullet Code.Scripts.Weapons.Bullet
Base class for all bullets in the game. Provides basic functionality for all bullets Code.Scripts.Weapons.BulletMath
Utility class for bullet math operations Code.Scripts.Environment.Coin
Coin class which handles the coin collection and movement Code.Scripts.UI.CoinDisplay
Updates the coin display label when the coin count changes Code.Scripts.Managers.CoinManager
Manager class that handles the coins of the player Code.Scripts.Environment.DamageNumber
Controls the damage number that appears when an entity takes damage Code.Scripts.Components.DamageNumberController
Controls the spawning of the DamageNumber scene Code.Scripts.Enemies.DummyBehaviour
Dummy behaviour, which only rotates towards the player and does nothing else Code.Scripts.Enemies.DummyTankCode.Scripts.Enemies.Enemy
Coordinates health, animation and trail components of an enemy Code.Scripts.UI.EnemyHealthBar
Shows the health of an enemy Code.Scripts.Weapons.GrenadeBullet
Controls the grenade bullet Code.Scripts.Weapons.GunController
Controls the gun of the player and enemies, handling the shooting of bullets, rotation and weapon stats Code.Scripts.UI.HealthBar
Displays the players health bar Code.Scripts.Components.HealthComponent
Component that handles the health of an entity Code.Scripts.Components.HitFeedbackComponent
Component that handles the flash and size change of the tank when it takes damage Code.Scripts.Weapons.HomingBullet
Controls the homing bullet Code.Scripts.Enemies.InvisBehaviour
Invis behaivour of the invis (purple) enemy Code.Scripts.Enemies.KamikazeBehaviour
Invis behaivour of the kamikaze (yellow) enemy Code.Scripts.Weapons.Laser
Controls the laser beam, checks for collisions and updates the laser beam particles Code.Scripts.Weapons.LaserGun
Controls the laser gun which emits a laser beam Code.Scripts.Managers.Level.Level
Manages the level, enemies and coins. Emits signals when the level is completed or failed Code.Scripts.UI.LevelCountdown
Custom control class for the level countdown, which handles the countdown before the level starts Code.Scripts.Managers.Level.LevelData
Data class which holds the data of a level Code.Scripts.UI.LevelDisplay
Dynamically shows the levels of the current world anr their states Code.Scripts.UI.LevelFailed
Shows the death screen when the player dies Code.Scripts.Managers.Level.LevelManager
Manages the levels and worlds of the game, loading and saving the game, and handling level completion and failure Code.Scripts.Managers.LoadUserPreferences
Loads the user preferences and sets the window mode and volume accordingly Code.Scripts.UI.MainMenu
Controls the main menu Code.Scripts.Environment.MainMenuDummyTank
Controls the dummy tank in the main menu Code.Scripts.Audio.MusicControllerCode.Scripts.Enemies.NavigationController
Utility which provides navigation functionality to a 2D character Code.Scripts.Managers.ParticleController
Controller for emitting particles Code.Scripts.UI.PauseMenu
Controls the pause menu Code.Scripts.Managers.PlayerManager
Manages the player's stats and health Code.Scripts.Movement.PlayerMovement
The player movement script. Handles the movement of the player and the gun Code.Scripts.Movement.PlayerStats
Data class which holds the base and current player stats Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.PlayerStatsDisplay
Displays the player stats in the shop Code.Scripts.Enemies.RocketBehaviour
Behaivour of the rocket (blue) enemy Code.Scripts.Managers.Save.SaveData
Data class which holds the data, which can be saved Code.Scripts.Managers.Save.SaveManager
Manages the saving and loading of the games progress, player stats, and shop state Code.Scripts.Managers.Scene
Particle scenes that can be used to emit particles Code.Scripts.UI.SettingsMenu
Controls the settings menu Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopBaseTab
Base class for all shop tabs. Contains methods to get price tags and parse prices from them Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopButtons
Custom button class for the shop buttons, which sets the text of the button based on the buy status of the weapon/item Code.Scripts.Managers.ShopManager
Manages the shop, including the stats and weapons. It handles the buying, upgrading, unlocking and equipping of stats and weapons Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopMenu
Custom control class for the shop menu, which handles opening and closing the shop menu Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopPrices
Manages the text of the price tags in the shop and calculates the price of the items Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopStatsTab
Manages the stats tab of thje shop. Buys stats and increases the player stats based on the bought stats Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopWeaponsTab
Manages the weapons tab of the shop. Buys weapons and equips them based on the bought weapons Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.ShopWeaponStatsDisplay
Displays the weapon stats in the shop Code.Scripts.Audio.Sound
Struct that contains all the music names Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.Stat
Data struct which holds the name, list index, price, price tag, and quantity of a stat Code.Scripts.Components.TrailComponent
Component that emits a trail for the tank Code.Scripts.Managers.Save.UserPreferences
Manages saveing and loading of user preferences/settings Code.Scripts.UI.VictoryScreen
Shows the victory screen when the player wins the game Code.Scripts.UI.Shop.Weapon
Data class which holds the weapon stats Code.Scripts.Weapons.WeaponStats
Data class which holds the stats of a weapon Code.Scripts.Managers.Level.WorldData
Data class which holds the data of a world
